description: Government bond auctions in a date window, soonest first: US Treasury, the German Finanzagentur and the Italian Treasury, calendar and results. Each has the auction day, closeAt (the bidding deadline in UTC), instrument, tenor, CUSIP/ISIN and size once known, status (scheduled, announced, held, cancelled), the issuer's result page and its format, and the result (yield, bid-to-cover, allotted) only once the issuer has published it. Facts only, no forecasts.
